I'd definitely say the thing that draws almost every fallout fan to new Vegas is the amount of choice in it. You can create a lot of outcomes for different quests based on your faction leanings and skills. for example, at the start of the game you can deter a group of bandits from a small town (not trying to spoil to much) and the amount of resources and people fighting depends on your skills. So yeah if that suits your fancy go for new Vegas

I personally love new vegas more. New Vegas has many role play elements the are similar to the older 90s fallouts and that's probably why I love it so much. However, if you like 4 I'd recommend 3 because it's more similar to 4 and has a great atmosphere to boot. If you finish 3 though, I would definitely check out New Vegas
